name: Bespoke AI Refrigerators
description: Category: Refrigerators. Types available: French Door, Side-by-Side, Top Freezer, Bottom Freezer, 4-Door Flex, and Family Hub smart refrigerators. Family Hub models have a built-in touchscreen and an internal AI Vision camera that helps you see and manage what food you have. Bespoke models have customizable door panels to match your kitchen, and AI-driven food management. Connects to the SmartThings app. Price: to be confirmed by the store team.

name: Bespoke AI Laundry (Washers, Dryers & Combo)
description: Category: Washing machines and dryers. Types available: front-load washers, top-load washers, separate dryers, the Bespoke AI Laundry Combo (washer and dryer in one unit), and stacked Laundry Hubs. Features EcoBubble and Bubble Shot technology for effective cleaning, and AI OptiWash, which adjusts the wash to the load. Connects to the SmartThings app. Price: to be confirmed by the store team.

name: Cooking & Kitchen Appliances
description: Category: Cooking. Types available: slide-in and freestanding gas and induction ranges, cooktops (hobs), range hoods, built-in wall ovens, and microwave ovens in convection, solo, and grill types. Selected ovens have a Smart Oven Camera so you can check on your food, and touchscreen AI Hub controls. Price: to be confirmed by the store team.

name: Smart Dishwashers

description: Category: Vacuum cleaners. Bespoke Jet AI cordless stick vacuums with an auto-empty station, Jet Bot AI+ robot vacuum cleaners, and multi-surface cleaning accessories. Price: to be confirmed by the store team.
